title: Best version of 'a-cappella': The Signature A Cappella Database
body:
Best version of the database subject 'a-cappella': The Signature A Cappella Database (a-cappella-signature), holding 20 records. Why: BEST-VERSION RULE (deterministic, applied identically to every record): 1) the edition / file variant with the highest record_count (or, for files, the greatest byte size, i.e. the most complete variant) wins; 2) tie-break: the Signature edition wins over the public edition (for files: the manifest-declared local_index file wins); 3) final tie-break: alphabetical slug (or filename) order. Losing editions/variants are named with their counts on every record. Recompute: compare the figures on the record with the manifest; the rule above reproduces the verdict. Competing editions considered (2): The Signature A Cappella Database with 20 records [Signature]; The A Cappella Database with 20 records. The winning edition is the most complete version of this subject in the system; the others remain available as alternate editions.

Signature analysis: the best-version verdict for 'a-cappella' is a-cappella-signature. The Signature verdict agrees with the deterministic rule: a-cappella-signature leads the nearest edition by 0 records. This tracking database itself is a Signature analysis of manifest-derived facts.
